title: Optimize Discord Performance
name: optimize-discord
modal: This tweak safely terminates running instances, disables hardware acceleration to free 100% GPU/VRAM for games, disables in-game overlay hook to eliminate FPS drops, enables minimize-to-tray, and purges accumulated caches, crashpad dumps, and telemetry logs.
deepDescription:
Applies the following optimizations for Discord:

- Terminate Active Processes → Safely closes running Discord instances before applying to prevent file locks
- Disable Hardware Acceleration → Frees 100% GPU and VRAM for the game, eliminating GPU contention and stutters
- Disable In-Game Overlay Hook → Eliminates DirectX/Vulkan frame hooking micro-stutters and input lag
- Disable Open on Windows Startup → Prevents boot slowdown and background memory consumption
- Enable Minimize to Tray → Reduces background RAM and viewport rendering when closed
- Clear Caches, Telemetry & Logs (Cache, GPUCache, Crashpad, logs) → Frees disk space and removes telemetry clutter
description: Disables Discord hardware acceleration and overlay hook, cleans caches, crashpad dumps and telemetry logs
